issues.message: No version or update date found. Helps track freshness of instructions.
No identity/persona defined. Without this, the agent has no consistent personality.
No tool documentation found. The agent doesn't know what tools are available or how to use them.
No boundaries or constraints defined. The agent needs to know what NOT to do.
No user context found. Telling the agent about its user (preferences, role, timezone) improves responses.
No priority guidance found. Help the agent know what's most important when instructions conflict.
No prompt injection defense found. The agent is vulnerable to instruction override attacks.
No session handoff protocol found. The agent doesn't know what to read or do when waking up in a new session.
No file-based memory system (daily notes, logs). Consider structured note-taking for long-term knowledge.
Memory strategy exists but missing explicit 'write it down' principle. Mental notes don't survive restarts.
No task/state tracking mechanism. The agent can't resume work from where it left off.
No learning loop defined. The agent doesn't know how to improve over time from past interactions.
Skill missing author field — unattributed skills are harder to trust.
